create_fast_qwen3_model: create a fast Qwen3 model using FastQwen3Model.from_pretrained with KV cache optimization
run_qwen3_attention_forward: run Qwen3Attention_fast_forward with hidden states, causal mask, and KV cache for training
run_qwen3_inference: run Qwen3Attention_fast_forward_inference with KV cache for fast autoregressive generation
patch_qwen3_attention: patch Qwen3Attention, Qwen3SdpaAttention, and Qwen3FlashAttention2 with fast forward methods
apply_qwen3_rope_embedding: apply fast RMS layernorm and rotary position embedding to Q, K, V tensors in Qwen3 attention
